name: Eu2O3 cubic bixbyite
citation: Z. K. Heiba, Y. Akin, W. Sigmund and Y. S. Hascicek (2003). X-ray structure and microstructure determination of the mixed sesquioxides (Eu1-xYbx)2O3 prepared by a sol-gel process. Journal of Applied Crystallography 36, 1411-1416.
conditions_evidence: Neither numeric diffraction temperature nor pressure is specified in the deposited CIF or verified author-repository abstract; left unknown.
method: Experimental powder X-ray diffraction and Rietveld refinement; pure x=0 Eu2O3 specimen from the measured sol-gel series, as confirmed by the original-author institutional repository abstract.
synthesis_conditions_note: Sol-gel synthesis is reported; numeric synthesis temperature/pressure not verified and not substituted for measurement conditions.
selection: Selected experimental reference; no FEFF calculation or experimental EXAFS validation performed in source research.
notes: The selected source contains only Eu and O, each at explicit occupancy 1; mixed Eu/Yb compositions in the same article are excluded.
Both inequivalent Eu sites are required: multiplicities 8 and 24, population weights 0.25 and 0.75. FEFF degeneracy is per absorber; ensemble paths need explicit normalized site weighting.
This is a trivalent Eu2O3 reference; it does not represent divalent Eu or validate valence discrimination.

Lanthanide L3 paths are EXAFS candidates, not validated white-line, multiplet, magnetic, or XANES models. The FEFF8.2 manual documents frozen-f density by default and possible f-element SCF convergence difficulties; retain actual engine recipe and logs.
